description: 국토교통부_고속시외버스·도시철도이용 OD [railways and stations and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 고속·시외버스 및 도시철도 이용 O/D 일간 데이터는 승객의 출발지와 도착지 정보를 기반으로 이동 경로를 기록한 자료로, 대중교통 이용 패턴을 심층 분석하고 교통 네트워크 효율성 개선에. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 일별고속시외버스, 도시철도이용OD, OD이용데이터, 고속버스이용패턴, 시외버스OD분석. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
